Plugging in , we have . Rewriting and combining with using this fact, we have Rewriting using this fact, we have (i.e., is even). We may henceforth limit to the positive reals without loss of generality. Rewriting and and employing the fact that is even, we have \begin{align*} f(x^2-y^2)+2y^2f(x)&=x^2f(x)+y^2f(y)\\ f(y^2-x^2)+2x^2f(y)&=y^2f(y)+x^2f(x)\\ \implies f(x^2-y^2)+2y^2f(x)&=f(y^2-x^2)+2x^2f(y)\\ \implies 2y^2f(x)&=2x^2f(y)\\ \implies \frac{f(x)}{x^2}&=\frac{f(y)}{y^2} \end{align*} Since the choice of was arbitrary, we find that is constant for all , so for some constant .
